source_excerpts.text:
Material rotation corrected the first comparison

For a physical tensor with strain-independent intrinsic eigenvalues whose axes
rotate with the skin, the ionic ODE has a first-order distributed source.
The elastic rotation amplitude Rrot is harmonic, with endpoints1,m. The exact
particular potential -G Rrot cancels the moving-face base-field shifts. Hence

 N_rot=-chi(C+LpS)-j0mR_v
       -j0[(S/p+LC)Rrot'(0)-L Rrot'(b)],
 Rrot'(0)=q[m-cosh(qb)]/sinh(qb),
 Rrot'(b)=q[m cosh(qb)-1]/sinh(qb).

For rho>=1 a positive Green-kernel argument proves N_rot<=N_frozen. The old
responsive all-q sufficient certificate therefore survives this constitutive
repair. Its old ordinary-coating instability witness does not survive as a
physical comparison: the corrected ordinary coating can already be stable.

Actual conditional proof and replay

ELASTIC_INTERFACE.txt proves an explicit all-q bound using positive elastic
energy, a low-q lower transmission m_min, positive-series chord bounds and a
cubic polynomial. elastic_interface.py executes exact rational Taylor remainder
and Bernstein inequalities: left5.1507956028>upper1.3047577299. High-q stiffness
handles the remaining continuum. A separate rational frozen-axis ordinary-mode
witness is positive, but is labeled for that constitutive model only.

CONVECTED_INTERFACE.txt gives the corrected ordinary-coating all-q bound.
convected_interface.py proves its low-q numerator is at most-17.9742551V/m for
the original1MPa skeleton fixture; high-q stiffness proves the rest. Thus both
corrected designs are stable there. The surviving gain is long-wave leveling:
350.662micrometres of mean deposition per e-fold for the identical ordinary
skin/support, versus9.09466micrometres with R_v, a factor38.5569. This is a
paid operating-point comparison, not overall superiority over ordinary methods.

A separate weak-support10kPa model region has a rational ordinary-skin positive
numerator>.699865V/m at q4000/m, while the responsive design remains all-q
stable. No weak-support material/contact conjunction is asserted acquired.
Finite24-case independent Airy boundary solves and ionic solves have residuals
around1e-15 and2e-16; those diagnose implementation, while the analytic/rational
inequalities supply the continuum statements. Root and the independent warm
thermal owner reviewed the earlier frozen-coefficient theorem; their reviews
do not auto

statement: The convected-axis ionic model adds a distributed source. For rho>=1 its positive Green-kernel comparison preserves the responsive sufficient stability bound, but the former ordinary-coating instability witness no longer establishes a physical advantage. Both corrected designs are stable at the original 1MPa fixture.
title: Rotating material axes invalidate a frozen-axis coating comparison
